import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
FP = 48
HID = 32


class FootHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, FP, 1)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(FP, FP, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.mids = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(FP, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = F.relu(self.proj(f))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), cv, md, out in zip(self.fps, self.convs, self.mids, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            h = F.relu(cv(q))
            h = F.relu(md(h))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = FootHead(COL + WIDTH, spec.footprints)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(torch.cat([s, f], dim=1))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
L = 24
F2 = 24


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.Z = Z
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.register_buffer("zpos", torch.eye(Z).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1))
        self.lin = nn.Conv2d(11 + Z, L, 1)
        self.tproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, L, 1)
        self.mid = nn.Conv2d(L, L, 1)
        self.fconv = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(L, F2, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.fout = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(F2, 2, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        T = len(self.fps)
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

        b = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tg = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        ms = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        ex = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        bb = F.pad(b, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        tb = F.pad(tg, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        ba = F.pad(b, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, 1:]
        ta = F.pad(tg, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, 1:]
        per = torch.stack([b, tg, ms, ex, bb, tb, ba, ta], dim=2)
        gin = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zp = self.zpos.expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        li = torch.cat([per, gin, zp], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 11 + Z, Y, X)
        tp = self.tproj(f).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, L, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, L, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.lin(li) + tp)
        h = F.relu(h + self.mid(h))

        scores = []
        gates = []
        for (dy, dx), cv, out in zip(self.fps, self.fconv, self.fout):
            q = F.pad(h, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            o = out(F.relu(cv(q)))
            scores.append(o[:, 0])
            gates.append(o[:, 1])
        sc = torch.stack(scores, 1).reshape(B, Z, T, Y, X)
        gt = torch.stack(gates, 1).reshape(B, Z, T, Y, X)
        w = torch.softmax(gt, dim=1)
        place = (w * sc).sum(1).flatten(1)

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.pre = nn.Conv2d(COL + WIDTH, K, 3, padding=1)
        self.remap = nn.Linear(K * Y * X, int(spec.n_place))

        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        h = F.relu(self.pre(torch.cat([s, f], dim=1)))
        place = self.remap(h.flatten(1))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.97}

HID = 320


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        d_in = int(spec.in_channels) * int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.inp = nn.Linear(d_in, HID)
        self.h1 = nn.Linear(HID, HID)
        self.h2 = nn.Linear(HID, HID)
        self.pi = nn.Linear(HID, int(spec.n_actions))
        self.v = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.pi.bias)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.pi.weight.mul_(0.1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        h = F.relu(self.inp(obs.flatten(1)))
        h = F.relu(h + self.h1(h))
        h = F.relu(h + self.h2(h))
        return self.pi(h), self.v(h).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        X = int(spec.X)

        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH + STEM, K, 1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(K * Y * X, HID)
        self.mfc = nn.Linear(int(spec.n_actions), HID)
        self.h1 = nn.Linear(HID, HID)
        self.pi = nn.Linear(HID, int(spec.n_actions))
        self.v = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.pi.bias)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.pi.weight.mul_(0.1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = F.relu(self.s1(obs))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        r = F.relu(self.red(torch.cat([s, f], dim=1)))
        m = self.mfc(mask.to(obs.dtype))
        h = F.relu(self.fc(r.flatten(1)) + m)
        h = F.relu(h + self.h1(h))
        return self.pi(h), self.v(h).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

W = 48
HID = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.P = int(spec.n_place)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.T + 2
        self.s1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, 64, 1)
        self.s2 = nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=2, dilation=2)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.fconv = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * W, HID, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.fout = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(4 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = self.Y
        X = self.X
        m = mask[:, :self.P].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        yy = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xx = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([obs, m, yy, xx], dim=1)
        a = F.relu(self.s1(inp))
        s = F.relu(self.s2(a))
        h = F.relu(s + self.c1(s))
        h = F.relu(h + self.c2(h))
        h = F.relu(h + self.c3(h))
        f = torch.cat([s, h], dim=1)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), cv, out in zip(self.fps, self.fconv, self.fout):
            q = F.pad(f, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            res.append(out(F.relu(cv(q))))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.0007, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.93, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

D = 64
HID = 24


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.P = int(spec.n_place)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.T
        self.e1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, D, 1)
        self.e2 = nn.Conv2d(D, D, 1)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, self.Y * self.X, D))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(D, 4, 128, dropout=0.0, batch_first=True, norm_first=True)
            for _ in range(2)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.fconv = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(D, HID, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.fout = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = self.Y
        X = self.X
        m = mask[:, :self.P].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1)
        s = F.relu(self.e1(inp))
        s = self.e2(s)
        t = s.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos
        for layer in self.layers:
            t = layer(t)
        t = self.norm(t)
        f = t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), cv, out in zip(self.fps, self.fconv, self.fout):
            q = F.pad(f, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            res.append(out(F.relu(cv(q))))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([t.mean(1), t.amax(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 512, "rollout_len": 8, "n_minibatches": 64, "ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.002, "ent_coef": 0.001, "gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.P = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(int(spec.in_channels) + self.T, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(COL + WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * (COL + WIDTH), 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.P].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        h = torch.cat([s, f], dim=1)
        place = self.head(h)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds, so the default setup learns essentially nothing about exact builds. My guess is the bottleneck is too few PPO updates: 131k steps at 4,096 per update is only 32 updates. Changing the recipe to 2 epochs and 2,048 samples per update gives about 243k steps and roughly 118 updates at the same compute. A second suspect is the placement head. Its max/min/avg pooling cannot tell exactly where the landing layer is under a footprint, or whether the target fills that layer there. So: (1) the recipe change alone on the starting network; (2) the same recipe with an exact-footprint convolution head; (3) the same recipe with a per-layer head, whose shared 2D weights score each layer z and then weight the layers with a learned softmax over z, so it can learn which layer the brick lands on.
analyses.2: All three round-1 trials scored 0 on dev, and also 0 on training success over the last 10% of training. They tried more updates, an exact-footprint conv head and a per-layer gated head. So no head design has produced any signal yet. The baseline pooling head should already be able to represent the common case of a brick landing on a flat surface: per column, 'target has the cell at the current height', then the minimum over the footprint and a height-equality check. That points to optimisation, sample volume or exploration as the bottleneck rather than what the network can represent. One possible failure is the policy collapsing to DONE early, because random placements earn negative reward. Minibatch size does not count against compute, so smaller minibatches give more optimizer steps for free. With 1 epoch, the agent gets about 3.25x the samples. This round tests sample-heavy recipes on the baseline network, a long-horizon, higher-entropy recipe, and a stronger per-column stem whose features feed the head directly.
analyses.3: All six trials score exactly 0. That holds on dev and on training success, across three heads (pooled, footprint-conv, per-layer gated) and four recipes (more samples, more updates, longer horizon, more entropy). Seed noise cannot explain 0 everywhere. Every head so far assumes the conv output at cell (y,x) for type t lines up with action t*Y*X + y*X + x, as described. If this world maps actions differently (for example y and x transposed, a different type order, or swapped footprints), a translation-equivariant conv head cannot fit that mapping, and every trial would fail in this way. The task warns that the world may differ from its description. So this round tests heads that make no assumption about how action indices map to cells: a learned dense map from spatial features to every action logit, used with the conv trunk and in a plain MLP. A nonzero score from any of them would be strong evidence that the mapping is the problem.
